visual_mood: Editorial luxury, warm cream and off-white backgrounds, deep charcoal text, sophisticated serif typography paired with clean modern sans-serif. Minimalist and refined structure.

hero_background.description: Full-bleed interior design photography for Hero section

studio_team.description: Team/Studio architecture image for the 50/50 Editorial Section

instructions_to_main_agent.overview: Implement an editorial luxury layout for an Italian interior design studio named 'Studio'. The background colors should alternate between pure white (#FFFFFF) and warm cream (#F5F0EB). Text should be deep charcoal (#111111) to replace any default cyan/teal colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='nav-link-chi-siamo').

dom_structure_updates.Header: Light/cream background. Left: serif logo 'Studio'. Center: nav links (CHI SIAMO, PROGETTI, SERVIZI, MAGAZINE, PER I PROFESSIONISTI). Right: outlined CTA 'PRENOTA UNA CONSULENZA' and 'ACCEDI' link.
dom_structure_updates.Hero: Full-bleed image with dark overlay. Large serif heading 'Il tuo spazio. Il nostro progetto.' Two CTAs: Primary filled dark charcoal ('RACCONTACI IL TUO PROGETTO'), Secondary ghost outline ('PER I PROFESSIONISTI').
dom_structure_updates.How_It_Works: Section titled 'COME LAVORIAMO'. Light bg. 4 horizontal steps using flex/grid. Large numbers (01, 02, 03, 04) above bold step titles. A chevron arrow '>' must physically sit between the steps (not after the last one).
dom_structure_updates.Editorial_Studio: Section 'LO STUDIO'. 2-column 50/50 split. Left side: eyebrow 'LO STUDIO', large serif title 'Progettiamo ambienti che migliorano la vita.', text paragraph, text link 'SCOPRI DI PIÙ SU DI NOI →'. Right side: full-bleed image.
dom_structure_updates.Projects: Section 'PROGETTI SELEZIONATI'. 3-column grid for cards. Cards must be borderless. Image aspect ratio 4/3. Followed by serif title, location, and 'SCOPRI IL PROGETTO →' text link.
dom_structure_updates.Digital_Journey: Cream bg section. Left: bold serif title 'Il tuo progetto inizia prima del primo incontro.', text, link. Right: 2x2 grid of 4 icon cards. Icons: file, heart, list, plus.
dom_structure_updates.Magazine: Section 'ISPIRAZIONE E APPROFONDIMENTI'. 3 horizontal article cards in a flex row. Each card has a small square thumbnail on the left, title on the right, and 'LEGGI IL ARTICOLO →'. Standalone 'VEDI TUTTI GLI ARTICOLI →' link on far right.
dom_structure_updates.Final_CTA: Dark background (#121212). 3-column grid: Left: large serif 'Pronto a iniziare il tuo progetto?', Center: primary button (white background, dark text), Right: Secondary contact prompt placeholder text.
dom_structure_updates.Footer: Dark background (#121212). 4 columns (2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr). Col 1: Logo + tagline + social. Col 2: NAVIGAZIONE. Col 3: PER I PROFESSIONISTI. Col 4: INFORMAZIONI. Bottom bar with copyright.
